name: Runner Tests Fixture - Tdd Enum Args
brief: Proves --tdd (issue #5038) infers an Enum parameter type from an enum-value argument when generating a missing procedure, and still refuses an Option-member argument.
description: One test codeunit per call shape: an enum-value argument, an integer literal next to an enum value, an enum-typed variable, and an enum declared in a namespace the implementing codeunit does not import. A fifth codeunit assigns an enum value to a missing table field. A sixth passes an Option member, which --tdd must still refuse.
